content: Nakabsilamaw

Kalin nuwag min-Yisleil yakamiy, amikum sinawatan akweiy, nukusikes ven babaw, ven kweitan kweitan wasigeis; gunalet neiw, kuvinis. Yey Yowbad natouwat, o daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis natouwat yey, yagag Yemes.
Simounid son sinap
Sigwey yakamiy, igaw bukulouvats mikabiyokon kweitan kweitan waseg, kadiloka kumwa̱saws silma̱nin.
Yowbad inakaleiwag ma̱wan. Kukin abamiy bigeg, kadiloka kusimounids beibwein waseg Yowbad mo bukwapatuls o bukutawtouns.
Kadiloka bukwapatuleimiy beibwein, sinap bwein mo bukukwawes beikous. Nag aveiyag bika̱bwag wasigeis yakamiy, nag.
Kal yak sinapun Yowbad nag kukwakin bwein, kadiloka kunitoug waseg Yowbad mo bisekeim, peinan singay tasiwa̱youb Yowbad. Mtowen nag bika̱neim, nag.

Kukin bukunitoug waseg Yowbad kadiloka bukunmis bwein. Kukin nag bukunamis bwein nag aveiyag bukuban, peinan nanoum akweiy. Kukin kal ivag nanon akweiy, ansinap mamagina kaysay wa̱yol ikivakuv ee... mo bika̱wot beim wakawalaw mo beikous. DaGuyaws nakaleiwag bo ma̱wan, nag aveiyag bisek taw towen, nag; peinan nanon babaw isisawl palatan palatan, nag aveiyag biban, nag.
Guyawaw o tasiyas tasimavs
Kadiloka bwadads tasimav teitan bimwa̱saw peinan Yowbad biyamwen.

Tage kadilok tasiyas guyawaw bimwa̱saws peinan biyabus; mamagina awuyow la̱lan bikalayag, beikous. Peinan igaw beivag ka̱las avakaein, mo beiyag awuyow, la̱lan bikalka̱louws, sikamnabwein beikous. E, guyawaw ma̱wan, igaw biwwotets-wan, nuwanaw mo bimta̱mats.
Dakabiyokons
Kal yak mukwabiyokon waseg bukusesun-wan kwaptuleim, mo bukuma̱saw kid. Yowbad bisekeim mula̱lan, mamagina mwamovam. Ya̱kids tasiwyoubus Yowbad, anilivan mounid bo bisekeids mwamovads.
Igaw mukwabiyokon waseg, awoum bukulivan, “Yowbad isimkineig”; awoum. Nag kal bisimkin Yowbad sinap kalbaleb silma̱nin; o Yowbad nag bisimkineid sinap kalbaleb silma̱nin, nag.
Tage nanoud tatoneid bisimkineid, igaw mo biseiw nuwad sinap kalbaleb silma̱nin.
Kukin nanoud waseg sinap kalbaleb, sinap towen bivakaein; nakabiyokous waseg bikop natun, yagan kanig.
Sigwey bwanabwein yakamiy, awoum teitan bikatidavimiy.

Tamads walba̱lab ansinap kamnat, mtowen issiwyoubuds youd babaw bwanabwein o sinap babaw bwanabwein. Nag teitan gamag bisiwyoubuds bwanabwein, nag. Yowbad anmwa̱net tut babaw ansinap katanok-wan, bwanabwein, kamnat.
Anilivan mounid waseg bo iva̱geids, va̱gan bitamugwas Yowbad inakabwabub waseg; peinan nanon bo ma̱wan.
Kadiloka bitaliganes liva̱nen Yeisuw
Sigwey bwanabwein yakamiy, kunages sinap towen. Nuwanaw kuliganes livan bwein, tage kadilok kuyouviys silma̱nin amilivan sona mikavikun. Ta-bukuwteles Yowbad nawotet mikavikun waseg, nag.
Kupiyaves geg sinap bikibik, son sinap babaw kalbaleb; kutams bwein waseg liva̱nen Kelis. Livan towen mo beisiw waninoumiy, bikatinabwes kululuwamiy silma̱nin Yowbad.
Livan towen awoum bukuliganesa mav, mogo bukwatidavimiy tatineimiy. Kadiloka kukwanawes livan towen.
Kukin kal binganega mav, mtowen mamagina gamag kavel ikin magin gilas waseg. Ikin ikous, inoun, mo inumlev ankakin ama̱wan. Tasiyas nuwanaw binumlaves kaleiwag bwein.

Tage kal yak bukukinbunik Yowbad nakaleiwag bwanabwein, waseg bilikuds mo taneis wamnat; o bukuvvalut waseg kaleiwag towen, mo bukumwa̱saw mukwawotet waseg. Kadiloka bukwanow livan towen; awoum kwatlutega mav, adok mo bukunumlev kid.
Kukin kal idok itapwa̱loul ibwein, tage nuwanaw wadon, bo ikatidavina tonen; itapwa̱loul mav.
Tapwa̱loul bwanabwein o kamnat silma̱nin Tamads Yowbad, mamagina bitalabes tasiyas gumakey o nakwabs, peinan abes igeg; o bitapiyaves ven watinow sinapun.
